VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the nexus determination issue and that "all 52 tests pass locally," there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Local test passage is not equivalent to verified acceptance criteria satisfaction, and the lack of any externally-verifiable artifacts means the fix cannot be independently validated.
